run_benchmark: run the EdgeTAM benchmark comparing PyTorch and CoreML model performance with timing and quality metrics
load_pytorch_model: load the PyTorch EdgeTAM model from a Hydra config and checkpoint file for CPU inference
load_coreml_models: load the CoreML image encoder, prompt encoder, and mask decoder models from mlpackage directories
benchmark_pytorch: benchmark the PyTorch EdgeTAM model by running multiple prediction passes and measuring latency in milliseconds
benchmark_coreml: benchmark the CoreML EdgeTAM models by running prompt encoding and mask decoding and measuring latency
